description: This Java source file defines a factory for creating SASL authenticators used by the AMQP adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. It implements mechanisms for supporting SASL PLAIN and EXTERNAL authentication, including handling SSL client certificates and username/password credentials, with tenant and device validation, connection limits, and tracing integration.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticatorFactory
classes.description: A factory class creating SASL authenticators for the AMQP adapter, supporting mechanisms like PLAIN and EXTERNAL with tenant validation and tracing.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticator
classes.description: Inner class managing the SASL authentication handshake for each connection, handling mechanism negotiation and credential verification.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the SASL authenticator.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SASL authenticator with socket, connection, and transport details.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the SASL process, including mechanism selection, response parsing, and credential verification.

methods.name: getSupportedMechanisms
methods.description: Returns the supported SASL mechanisms based on configured authentication providers.

methods.name: buildSaslResponseContext
methods.description: Constructs context objects from client's SASL response depending on mechanism.

methods.name: parseSaslResponse
methods.description: Parses the raw SASL response into usable fields.

methods.name: invokePreAuthenticationHandler
methods.description: Optionally invokes a pre-authentication handler after receiving the SASL response.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Dispatches credential verification based on mechanism.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Verifies username/password credentials via tenant service.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Verifies client certificates via trust anchors and tenant validation.

methods.name: getTenantObject
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on issuer DN or tenant ID.

methods.name: checkTenantIsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the AMQP adapter is enabled for the tenant.
